LONG-RUN ATTRIBUTION — Gerrit Verify run 31843821793 (2026-08-14)

- End-to-end wall: 1,992s (33m12s). Full-route admission before matrix: 78s. macOS runner queue: 3s. macOS job: 1,896s (31m36s). Final vote: 2s queue + 12s execution.
- macOS default suite: 1,591s workflow / 1,588.59s pytest. macOS integration: 193s workflow / 191.56s pytest. GitHub post-step/finalization time not visible as test execution: 62s.
- Ubuntu py3.11: 549s job; default 410.36s; integration 83.49s. Ubuntu py3.12: 559s; default 421.89s; integration 88.24s. Ubuntu py3.13: 809s; default 654.65s; integration 89.00s.
- The only individual test phase over 30s was editor-loopback fixture setup at 35.13s. No Ubuntu or integration test exceeded 30s.
- Mutation occupied 3,063 runner-seconds (51.05 runner-minutes): gates 718s, signing 657s, reducer-processors 611s, validate 447s, next-batch 391s. All mutation work finished 18m35s before macOS, so direct completion-path contribution in this run was 0s, while runner-contention cost remained large. Total run occupancy was 7,474 runner-seconds (124.57 runner-minutes).

THREE-RUN VARIATION
- 31837971444: wall 29m38s; macOS job 1,675s; default pytest 1,424.78s; integration 155.30s; hidden finalization 51s.
- 31842940708: effective wall 34m21s; macOS job 1,970s; default pytest 1,648.27s; integration 187.39s; hidden finalization 83s.
- 31843821793: wall 33m12s; macOS job 1,896s; default pytest 1,588.59s; integration 191.56s; hidden finalization 62s.

Conclusion: long-run variation tracks macOS test execution rather than runner queueing. Mutation is numerically expensive for contention but was not the completion critical path in these samples. Change 1793 adds thresholded decomposition of the one >30s individual fixture so the next full route can distinguish ThreadingHTTPServer construction, TCPServer.server_bind, and socket.getfqdn.
